messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — Brightlane EBR scheduled Tue 2026-04-05. Need final deck, one-pager, and an exec rehearsal. I'll consolidate slides into the canonical deck (Google link: https://docs.google.com/d/brightlane-ebr-draft). Who can own the onboarding health slide and who will do the renewal-risk table? Proposed rehearsal: Mon 2026-04-04 11:00am PT.

Kevin Singh: I can own onboarding health. Will pull: adoption metrics, activation funnel, 30/90 day usage, and open onboarding tickets. Will call out the two P0 onboarding blockers.

Olivia Park: I'll take the renewal risk table + mitigation plan. Quick question — do we want Dedicated infra cost/utilization on the renewals slide? cc @Mike Ortiz for billing context.

Sanjay Rao: I'll own technical readiness + demo smoke. Plan to run through the API flow and edge-case repro steps. Need staging creds to run full end-to-end — @Jason Liu can you confirm access to test tokens?

Jason Liu: Confirmed — test tokens are stored in 1Password in the Brightlane/staging folder. Ping me when you're ready and I'll rotate if needed. Also, let's include p95 latency and error-rate by route on the perf slide.

Heather Coleman: Rehearsal time works for me. For the exec summary, recommend 8min top-line + 2min ask. I'll draft the "asks" slide (contract ask + escalation path).

Maria Chen: Great. Can everyone add WIP content to the deck by EOD Friday? I'll send a calendar invite for the rehearsal after I see availability. Also we should capture feedback during the EBR — propose a 3-question feedback form: (1) top blocker, (2) satisfaction with onboarding, (3) follow-up owners. I'll attach a short Google Form in the deck.

Kevin Singh: :thumbsup: Adding usage charts now. Noted a usage dip in APAC region — will include a small chart and a hypothesis line.

Olivia Park: Added mitigation actions: weekly ops sync, enablement playbook share, and a proposed training for their infra team. Also added a one-sentence customer quote from the NPS follow-up.

Sanjay Rao: Running demo in staging at 3pm today, will paste logs here. Command I'm using: ```curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'```

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: staging inference stack updated at 15:01 UTC by deploy-bot — all smoke tests passed.

Jason Liu: Verified demo run results — p95 latency 240ms, no 5xx above baseline. Sanjay, please reference the trace id: trace-20260401-3pm if you paste logs.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Last coordination item: who can join the post-EBR 1:1 with Brightlane execs? Prefer Heather + Olivia, plus someone from billing. @Mike Ortiz can you do the billing readout (usage vs commit)?

Mike Ortiz: Yep — I'll prepare a usage vs commit chart and highlight overages & credit history.

Maria Chen: Perfect. I'll schedule rehearsal and invite: agenda = 10min exec summary, 25min product/ops walkthrough, 15min Q&A + action capture. Please label any slide you add with the owner name (slide footer) and add 'ready' or 'draft' in the comments. Rehearsal invite sent (calendar). See you Monday. :calendar: 

Heather Coleman: Thanks — I'll review the exec summary and finalize the asks slide by Friday EOD.

Kevin Singh: Done — onboarding slide updated (marking as DRAFT).

Olivia Park: Renewal slide updated and mitigation actions assigned to owners.

Maria Chen: Closing loop — rehearsal confirmed Mon 11:00am PT. If anything blocks you, call it out here. Otherwise, please be ready to present your slide for ~3 minutes each.

Jason Liu: All set from infra side.

Sanjay Rao: Demo ok, posted logs to the doc.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite for Brightlane EBR rehearsal created by @Maria Chen at 2026-03-31 18:12 UTC.

Maria Chen: Awesome — thanks team. We'll capture action items in the doc and I'll send a follow-up with action owners after the rehearsal.

Heather Coleman: :raised_hands:

Mike Ortiz: 👍
